question: When recent rain recruits route-new calling species, are those species x physical-site combinations mostly recurrent members observed at the same SiteID in other years, or combinations never observed elsewhere in the eligible time series?
population: Frozen NAAMP matched-pair design, restricted to pairs in which all ten StopNumbers retain the same nonmissing SiteID between wet and dry runs.
unit: Matched pair x physical SiteID x species incidence transition.

route_new_definition.gain: Species detected at a SiteID in the wetter run, absent from that SiteID in the drier run, and absent from the entire drier route.
route_new_definition.loss: Species detected at a SiteID in the drier run, absent from that SiteID in the wetter run, and absent from the entire wetter route.

recurrence_primary.recurrent: The same species was detected at the same physical SiteID in at least one other eligible run in the same seasonal-window stratum, excluding both runs in the focal pair.
recurrence_primary.rationale: Same RunNumber keeps recurrence within the same broad seasonal sampling window and exact SiteID preserves physical place identity.

pair_level_endpoints.recurrent_net: recurrent route-new gains minus recurrent route-new losses, summed across ten sites
pair_level_endpoints.novel_net: novel route-new gains minus novel route-new losses, summed across ten sites
pair_level_endpoints.total_route_new_net: all route-new gains minus all route-new losses; must equal recurrent_net + novel_net

model: Each pair-level endpoint ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber, cluster-robust by State x RouteNumber, exactly matching the current pair model.
prefixed_support_rule: Latent-site reactivation is supported if recurrent_net rainfall beta >0 with complete 95% CI >0, recurrent_net beta / total_route_new_net beta >0.5, and recurrent_net beta > novel_net beta.

sensitivities.prior_only: Classify recurrent only when same species x SiteID was observed in an eligible same-RunNumber run strictly before both focal pair years; report direction without a pass requirement because early pairs have less history.
sensitivities.any_season_window: Allow recurrence at the same SiteID in any RunNumber of the same route; directional diagnostic only.

interpretation_boundary: Recurrence of a species x SiteID supports repeated acoustic use, not continuous occupancy of that exact wetland.
A never-observed combination may be a detection-history limitation rather than true ecological novelty.
This distinguishes recurrent activation from apparent novelty; it does not identify hydration, inundation, social cues, or breeding success.
No causal rainfall claim and no RC11 submission change authorized.
